## Change and decision

Describe the decision, fix, or documentation update and the conditions it applies to.

## Evidence

List the checks you ran. For a knowledge change, link the primary source and say which edge case or alternative the record now covers.

- [ ] Canonical edits and generated outputs are synchronized where applicable.
- [ ] Commands, user docs, and translations match the tested behavior.
- [ ] Example, test, integration, or benchmark evidence identifies its scope.
- [ ] No credentials, private logs, personal paths, or unrelated agent instructions are included.
